domain-strategist.description: Reviews specs and feature ideas for real-estate market fit, customer pain-point accuracy, and product philosophy alignment before implementation. Read-only — no code, no file edits. Invoke with @domain-strategist during spec drafting in plan mode. Must load real-estate-outreach-domain skill.

compliance-reviewer.description: Reviews any spec or code touching WhatsApp message sending, templates, opt-out, rate-limiting, or the 24-hour window rule. Read-only — no code, no file edits. Mandatory before sending-spec implementation begins. Must load outreach-compliance skill.

spec-writer.description: Drafts and refines spec files in /specs following Spec-Driven Development conventions. Operates in plan mode only — no implementation. Must read MEMORY.md and AGENTS.md before drafting any spec. References depends_on ordering from MEMORY.md entry 14.

backend-builder.description: Implements Supabase schema migrations, contact cleaning logic, WhatsApp sending services, Inngest job queue, and lead scoring logic against an approved spec. Must not implement anything without an approved spec in /specs. Must load contact-cleaning-rules skill before any cleaning work and client-delivery-models skill before any schema work.

agent-architect.description: Designs and implements the AI-native agent layer: Agents SDK tool definitions, pgvector retrieval pipeline, guardrails logic, persona configuration, human_controlled gate, hot lead escalation, and structured output schemas. Must load ai-agent-design-patterns skill first. Never implements draft-and-approve — the agent is autonomous.

qa-reviewer.description: Reviews implemented code against its originating spec file before commit. Read-only — flags gaps and mismatches, does not fix them. Checks: does the implementation match the spec exactly? Are all MEMORY.md constraints honoured? Are guardrails and RLS present where required?
